name: Torn paper note
what: A torn sheet of ruled notebook paper with a folded corner lies on a speckled concrete floor, and bold lines of text fade onto it one after another: a big headline, a second line, then the note, one word a line, the last one running under the folded corner, while the whole scene pushes in slowly.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f119 (00:00:00:00-00:00:03:29) the whole scene pushes in about 20 % about the frame centre (a gentle S-curve, fastest around f57); the six lines fade in on an ease-in curve, each over about 6 frames: the headline at f2 (00:00:00:02), the second line at f6 (00:00:00:06), then the note's four lines at f11, f16, f26 and f32; then everything holds to the end. The reference only changes every third frame (10 fps content) and so does the template by default (the Choppy motion setting; 1 = a new picture on every frame)

tracks.name: push in
tracks.what: the sheet and the floor scale up about the frame centre, 1 x to 1.2 x

tracks.name: headline
tracks.what: the big headline fades onto the sheet

tracks.name: second line
tracks.what: the bold second line fades in

tracks.name: note line 1
tracks.what: the first word of the note fades in at the left

tracks.name: note line 2
tracks.what: the second word fades in, right-aligned

tracks.name: note line 3
tracks.what: the third word fades in, centred

tracks.name: note line 4
tracks.what: the fourth word fades in, centred, partly under the folded corner
